workflow_runs.display_title: Preserve owned bookmarks when Chrome lookup fails for another reason

head_commit.message:
Preserve owned bookmarks when Chrome lookup fails for another reason

Constraint: Only the observed missing-node rejection may release a deleted bookmark reference
Rejected: Substring matching for find bookmark/no bookmark | Also accepts permission, service and malformed-ID failures
Confidence: high
Scope-risk: narrow
Directive: Unknown Chrome lookup errors must retain the mapping and never issue remove
Tested: Controlled Chrome155 read-only getters with real extension/context and owned cleanup; Bookmarks9/9 including six unrelated error shapes
Not-tested: Installed-tool optional permission consent, external-delete UI, Worker restart and full same-candidate SDK native acceptance

workflow_runs.name: Native Agent R1 components and package
workflow_runs.display_title: Observe restarted plans and effects through their genuine document

head_commit.message:
Observe restarted plans and effects through their genuine document

Wait for canonical Sidebar initialization before real My navigation. Reset the restored fixture through navigation and bind the second Run to its actual tab/document, preserving the original Fire/Run/Result and webpage-effect assertions.

Constraint: main-only scoped staging; daily watcher and shared fixture remain untouched
Rejected: Weakening the recovered-plan or webpage-effect assertions | Would hide observation ambiguity and runtime failures
Confidence: high
Scope-risk: narrow
Directive: Keep real Side Panel, isolated viewport and native tab zoom evidence separate
Tested: Mac CFT149 same-profile full restart and exact second Run target PASS on frozen main8321 product; current 71 Node tests and source check PASS
Not-tested: Mac website revocation remains foreground-guard blocked; physical Side Panel width/zoom and whole daily extension parity unclosed
